scale.basis: Income Tax Act Cap. 81:01 ss. 36, 36A as amended by Act 2 of 2025: 'three million one hundred and twenty thousand dollars' (start of the 35 % band). A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Cap. 81:01)' confirmed: 2025 deduction the greater of 1,560,000 and one third of total income (s. 20(1)(a)), 120,000 per child under 18 to one parent, second-job and overtime deductions up to 600,000 each; 25 % on chargeable income to 3,120,000 and 35 % above (ss. 36, 36A); NIS employee contributions deductible (s. 16(1)(k)); NIS 5.6 % to 280,000 a month (Board rate, official secondary).
